notes: Wayfair-family site. Direct HTTP to allmodern.com was impossible from this host: TCP connect to both A records times out (allmodern.com/wayfair.com are IPv4-only and this host's IPv4 egress is dead; only AAAA-reachable hosts respond). No HTTP-layer bot block was ever reached. Worked around it by fetching the genuine AllModern pages through Google's translate proxy host www-allmodern-com.translate.goog (?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en), which returns AllModern's real server-rendered HTML incl. the Next.js RSC payload. Links below are the canonical www.allmodern.com URLs. Counts come from the listing page's own resultCount, confirmed independently by pageTrackingMetadata.totalSKUCount on every row (the two agreed on all 51 pages). Verified exactness two ways: Trivets resultCount=4 matched a full enumeration of 4 SKUs, and Oversized Wall Art resultCount=600 (48/page) has a populated page 13 and an empty page 14. Furniture, textiles (pillows/throws/curtains/linens), storage, bath, appliances, cookware, flatware sets, hardware, wallpaper/tile, clocks and 'All ...' view-all pages were excluded per brief.
